title: WPSB/371/2020 of LALIT KISHOR SHARMA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
2025:UHC:4797-DB
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
THE HON'BLE JUSTICE MR. MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
AND
THE HON'BLE JUSTICE MR. SUBHASH UPADHYAY
Writ Petition (S/B) No. 371 of 2020
9th June, 2025
Lalit Kishor Sharma -------Writ Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ------Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
None is present for the petitioner.
Mr. K.N.Joshi, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
JUDGMENT: (per Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
Petitioner has challenged the communication dated
28.10.2020 issued by Secretary, Secondary Education. By the
said communication, Director, Secondary Education was asked to
submit a report on certain points. Petitioner is aggrieved by para
4 of the said communication which provides that if on the date
of occurrence of vacancy on the post of Head Master (High
School) or Principal (Intermediate College), no teacher is eligible
for promotion as Head Master/Principal, then in that case, steps
shall be taken to fill such vacancy by direct recruitment.
Petitioner is also challenging the consequential letter issued by
Chief Education Officer, Dehradun on 18.11.2020.
2. We do not find any scope to interfere with the
communication issued by Secretary, Secondary Education and
the consequential letter issued by Chief Education Officer.
1

2025:UHC:4797-DB
3. Section 36 (2) of Uttarakhand School Education Act,
2006 provides that every post of Head of Institution or Teacher
shall except to the extent prescribed for being filled by
promotion, be filled by direct recruitment. Section 36 (2) of the
Act is reproduced below for ready reference.
"36. Procedure for selection of, teachers and heads of
institutions.-
(1)......................
(2) Every post of Head of Institution or teacher, of an
institution shall except to the extent prescribed for being filled
by promotion, be filled by direct recruitment after intimation of
the vacancy to the District Education Officer and obtaining
approval of the District Education Officer for advertising and
advertisement of the vacancy containing such particulars as
may be prescribed, in at least two daily newspapers having
wide circulation in the State."
4. Chapter 2 of the Regulations framed under
Uttarakhand School Education Act, 2006 deals with appointment
of Head of institutions and also teachers. Regulation 2 of
Chapter 2 reiterates that vacancy on the post of Head
Master/Principal has to be filled by direct recruitment, except
cases which are covered by Section 37(1) or Section 38(1) of
Uttarakhand School Education Act. Section 37(1) and Section
38(1) of the Act provides that selection for appointment as Head
of institution shall be made by a Selection Committee. Thus,
from the scheme of the Act and the regulations framed
thereunder, it is clear that post of Head of institution has to be
ordinarily appointed by direct recruitment and a vacancy on the
post can be filled by promotion if a teacher, who fulfills all
conditions of eligibility for promotion as Head of institution as
prescribed in proviso to Regulation 2 is available in the
institution.
5. In view of statutory scheme as discussed above, we
do not find any infirmity or illegality, whatsoever in the
2

2025:UHC:4797-DB
communication issued by Secretary, Secondary Education on
28.10.2020. Para 4 of the said Government Order is in
consonance with the statutory scheme, therefore we do not find
any reason to interfere with the same.
6. Petitioner was appointed as Assistant Teacher (C.T.)
Grade in a Government Aided institution on 21.04.1989, his
services were absorbed in the cadre of Assistant Teacher (L.T.)
Grade pursuant to G.O. dated 03.06.2005. Petitioner was
thereafter promoted as Lecturer on 22.10.2012. It is not in
dispute that the post of Principal in the concerned institution fell
vacant on 31.03.2016 and petitioner was not possessing the
requisite qualifications for appointment as Downgrade Principal
on the date vacancy arose on the post of Principal. Reportedly,
one Mr. Raghuvansh Kumar held charge as Principal between
01.04.2016 to 31.03.2017. Petitioner has sought a direction to
the authorities to approve his promotion as Down Grade
Principal w.e.f. 01.04.2017.
7. Counter affidavit has been filed by Ms. Asha Rani
Painuly, Chief Education Officer, District Dehradun on behalf of
respondent no. 4. Para 9 of the said counter affidavit is
reproduced herein below:
"9. That the petitioner is working with the Punjub Sindh
Skhetra Inter College, Rishikesh, Dehradun and the post
of the Principal is vacant due to the retirement of the
Principal on 31.03.2016, the petitioner has been
promoted on the post of Lecturer on 22.10.2012 and has
not completed the 10 years of services, therefore in
accordance with the provision of the government order
dated 18.10.2011, the petitioner is not having requisite
qualification and has not been granted the benefit of
downgrade Principal. In accordance/complied of the
provision of the Government Order dated 28.10.2020 the
advertisement for the appointment of the post of
Principal through direct recruitment, in the Punjab Sindh
Skhetra Inter College, Rishikesh, Dehradun has been
3

2025:UHC:4797-DB
issued, as the petitioner was not having requisite
qualification of the pay of the vacancy, therefore the
benefit of the post of downgrade Principal has not been
given to him."
8. Learned State Counsel submits that G.O. dated
18.10.2011 referred in the counter affidavit is actually a
notification whereby the Regulations were amended and
eligibility conditions for appointment as Downgrade Principal
were laid down.
9. Since petitioner does not meet the requirement of
the regulations for appointment as Downgrade Principal,
therefore direction as sought by him in prayer no. 2 cannot be
granted.
10. The writ petition is accordingly dismissed. It shall be
open to the authorities to take necessary steps for filling
vacancy on the post of Principal by direct recruitment.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.)
Dated: 09.06.2025
Kaushal
